profile.name: m6000-64g
profile.title: Quadro M6000 24 GB with 64 GB of RAM
profile.tested: 2026-11-18 on the reference system with RAM held so 59 GiB was available: speed 43.5 / 49.3 / 35.0 / 42.5 tok/s, balanced 39.4 / 44.2 / 33.9 / 41.9, quality 39.0 / 43.2 / 30.1 / 38.5 (chat / code / story / 4K doc), prompts 195 to 200 tok/s; every pack in full mode, switches about 70 s, answer checks passed
notes: Every pack keeps all its experts in RAM. With quality running, about 5 GiB of RAM is left for everything else, so the conversation cache is kept to 4 GiB.

Measured again 2026-11-23 with 60 and 52 GiB available: the read settings every profile has (m6000-base) leave quality's speed as it was and halve what it reads from the disk when other programs push it into the low-RAM mode.

speed.description: Q2_0 pack, 2.4 bits/weight: the fastest; task average 89.1 against the original's 93.1

quality.description: IQ3_S pack, 3.5 bits/weight: task average 93.3, level with the original model
